Sound familiar?

You didn’t fail at the old life. You outgrew it.

  • On paper it all looks right: the title, the salary, the reviews. It just doesn’t feel like you anymore.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why high achievers outgrow systems they once trusted

And why that is a sign of growth, not a sign that something is wrong with you.

The question that starts every identity pivot

“Who do you want to be?” How to answer it honestly, without the old job title doing the talking.

How to meet future you

A guided exercise to picture the version of you on the other side of the change, and what she does differently.

Before you grab your seat

Do I need to know what I want to do next?

No. Most people arrive with a feeling, not a plan. The class is built to help you find the shape of it.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Your seat includes the replay.

Is this therapy?

No. It’s an educational coaching class. It isn’t therapy or medical advice, and it doesn’t replace working with a licensed professional.

Why is it free?

Because the first step should be easy. Come, do the work with me for an hour, and decide afterwards if you want to go deeper.

Script 1 · “Outgrown”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Nobody tells high achievers this: you can outgrow a life you worked really hard to build.”

Body

“The title still looks good on paper. The work still gets done. It just stops feeling like yours. That isn’t failure. It’s the moment you’re ready to decide who you want to be next, on purpose.”

CTA

“I’m teaching exactly how in a free 60-minute masterclass called The Identity Pivot. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: Lauren talking to camera in the blush blazer, warm light. On-screen text “outgrown”. End card: “Educational content, not medical advice.”

Script 2 · “Wrong question”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“‘What should I do next?’ is the wrong question.”

Body

“When you start with the job, you end up with another version of the same life. Start with who you want to be, and the job, the business and the boundaries start to follow. I call it the identity pivot.”

CTA

“I’ll walk you through it live. Free, 60 minutes, replay included. Tap Sign up.”

Shot: talking to camera, cut to on-screen text crossing out “What should I do next?” and writing “Who do I want to be?”.

Script 3 · “Memo from future you”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Try this: write a memo from yourself, one year from now.”

Body

“Where does she wake up? What did she say no to? What is she proud of? Most people find they already know more than they think. They’ve just never been asked the right way.”

CTA

“We do this exercise together in my free masterclass, The Identity Pivot. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: Lauren writing in a notebook on the cognac leather chair, cut to talking to camera.
